expectations.text: Exactly four numbered steps in original operational order.
expectations.evidence: Exactly four numbered items: "1. Run", "2. Create a snapshot", "3. Run", and "4. Check" retain status → snapshot → apply → health check order.

expectations.text: Every source code span is preserved exactly, including both /healthz occurrences and rollback command.
expectations.evidence: Exact ordered code-span comparison with the source passes: "deployctl status --env staging", "deployctl snapshot --label pre-release", "deployctl apply release.yaml --env staging", "/healthz", "/healthz", and "deployctl rollback --label pre-release".

expectations.text: HTTP 200 check and rollback after 60 seconds on non-200 remain required, not optional or unconditional.
expectations.evidence: "Check `/healthz` for HTTP 200. If `/healthz` is not HTTP 200 after 60 seconds, run `deployctl rollback --label pre-release`." Both the required check and conditional rollback are imperative.

review_method: Independent single blind agent review; not human feedback
